family: GTK2 GtkEntry normal face and static DomainOS SR10.4 comparison
correction_to: R33; R33 is retained as an audit record, but its Window/WindowText mapping conclusion was incorrect and is superseded here.

implementation.summary: Restored KDE View/ViewText for the normal GtkEntry face and text, with KDE Selection/SelectionText for selected text. The incorrect Window mapping proposed in R33 is not active. The focused test now puts disposable output under ~/tempia.

historical_reference.system: Domain/OS SR10.4 with HP VUE 2.01, MAME capture from 2026-10-14

measured_roles.field_face: KDE View BackgroundNormal, RGB sampled as (102,136,181)

historical_reference.state_limit: The static reference shows a blank field. It does not establish focus, caret, selection, or active-editing appearance.

comparison.method: Direct crop comparison between native GTK2 rendering and the measured SR10.4 field rectangle.

tests.native_scenes: 24 passed: four color schemes x three states x separate/coupled origins.
tests.keyboard_editing: passed: UTF-8, select/replace, copy/paste/cut, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z, multi-step undo and native edit popup.
tests.public_preview_route: not revalidated in this step; no claim of public route or user-session delivery.

limits: The exact pixel match covers only the blank, normal SR10.4 field rectangle; it does not establish that all GTK2 Entry states or typography match Motif/VUE.
Focus ring, caret and selection appearance still need a corresponding historical VM reference before visual claims are made.
A separate current live MAME read-only snapshot was black outside the Apollo command strip; this did not invalidate the archived 2026-10-14 static VUE capture used above.
GTK2 as a whole is incomplete; nothing was applied to the personal session or XChat.
next: Continue the GTK2-only family sequence from the current authorized I167 scope. Before claiming the GtkEntry family complete, classify a focused/selected reference if available; otherwise keep those states explicitly unverified. The public preview gate and remaining GTK2 families precede applying the finished GTK2 theme to XChat.
